title: Jude and the Current
author: J. M. Vasquez
blurb: Odile Winterbourne, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
